hooks.command: filepath="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [ -n "$filepath" ] && echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.resolved$|\.dmg$|\.build/'; then echo 'BLOCK: do not edit build artifacts directly'; exit 2; fi
filepath="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [ -n "$filepath" ] && echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.env|\.pem|credentials'; then echo 'BLOCK: sensitive file — confirm manually'; exit 2; fi

filepath="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [ -n "$filepath" ] && echo "$filepath" | grep -q '\.swift$'; then root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && cd "$root/NetMounter" && swift build 2>&1 | tail -20; fi

filepath="${CLAUDE_FILE_PATH:-}"; if [ -n "$filepath" ] && echo "$filepath" | grep -q '\.swift$'; then root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && cd "$root/NetMounter" && swift test 2>&1 | tail -5; fi
